editorial.description_en: Standing water with weed under it — yellow-green, and dulled by everything suspended in it.
editorial.description_ja: 沼の水面のような、にごった黄緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.590, C 0.038, h 134.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 沼 (numa, marsh) + 面 (omote, surface). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Marsh Surface" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 沼面. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yama-kage at ΔE00 8.1, sugi-kage at ΔE00 8.2, ja-mon at ΔE00 8.3. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.038 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
